product_name: Fraupow Steam Clean Microwave Steriliser Bags | Pack of 10

product_name: Badabulle Safe & Pass Automatic Safety Gate
description: The Badabulle Safe & Pass Automatic Safety Gate in Grey is designed to keep your little explorer safe while making everyday life that little bit easier. With its clever automatic unlocking system, there's no need to fumble with latches – simply move closer, and the built-in detection sensor will unlock the gate. With its sleek metal finish, the Safe & Pass baby gate blends beautifully into any home while giving you the confidence that your little one is safe and sound.

product_name: Babymoov Moov & Hike Baby Carrier - Sage Green
description: The Babymoov Moov & Hike Baby Carrier in Sage Green is designed for adventure-loving families, ensuring both parent and child experience maximum comfort while exploring the outdoors together. Developed alongside physiotherapists, parents, and outdoor equipment specialists, this ergonomic baby carrier provides a natural and adjustable Physiohike® seat that supports the optimal 90° leg position, promoting healthy hip and spine development. The soft, breathable 3D mesh head support ensures proper ventilation and keeps your baby’s head comfortably positioned, even during naps. For parents, the QuickFit® adjustment system allows for an effortless switch between wearers, accommodating all body types from XS to XXL. A spacious 10L diaper bag with an insulated pocket keeps essentials within easy reach, while additional features like a UV and water-repellent sunshade, dummy clip, hydration compartment, and head cushion make every trip stress-free. From short strolls to extended hikes, the Moov & Hike Baby Carrier provides the perfect blend of comfort, support, and practicality, allowing families to share unforgettable outdoor moments together.

product_name: CYBEX Cloud G i-Size Plus Car Seat - Almond Beige - No Base

product_name: CYBEX Gazelle S Double Pushchair - Almond Beige / With Carrycot
description: The CYBEX Gazelle S Pushchair is a future-ready companion for growing families, offering over 20 configurations to suit newborns, siblings or twins. From single mode to duo mode, simply mix and match Gazelle cots, seats or CYBEX car seats to create the set-up that works for you. Despite its generous size and impressive carrying capacity, the Gazelle S folds compactly for easy storage at home or in your car boot. A one-pull harness makes on-the-go buckle-ups quick and fuss-free, especially with two little ones. Thoughtfully designed and endlessly adaptable, the Gazelle S is the pushchair that grows right alongside your family. Perfect for families with children of different ages, the Gazelle S adapts effortlessly as your family grows. You can choose a second lie-flat seat unit, or combine your main seat with a Gazelle S Cot to give your newborn a cosy, safe space to sleep. It’s a simple, flexible way to tailor the pushchair to your family’s needs.

product_name: CYBEX e-Gazelle Double Pushchair - Almond Beige / With Carrycot

product_name: Obaby Astrid Mini Cot Bed - White - No Mattress
description: The Obaby's Astrid Mini Cot Bed is an opulent cot bed that has sleek lines. This design also comes with handleless drawers and doors for optimal convenience; you can contribute effortless practicality and style when decorating your dream nursery. The Astrid will grow with your little one, it's suitable from birth until approximately 4 years old with its adjustable base height. Allow yourself and your beloved little one to bask in the captivating beauty of Nordic heritage with a little help from Obaby's Astrid Cot Bed–Satin. With peace of mind, you know your little one is safe, sound and comfortable as they drift off into their sweet dreams, night after night. With the Obaby Astrid Cot Bed, you can pick between three mattress options: no mattress, pocket sprung mattress and the moisture management mattress. The Obaby Pocket Sprung Mattress is fantastic for providing babies with optimum support and luxurious levels of comfort during their slumber. Individual pocket springs are cleverly integrated to give increased support to your little ones' back, neck and head during sleep. Promoting perfect posture and sweet dreams for your little one. These individual springs are then encased in a high-grade of dent-resistant nursery foam ensuring superior comfort. The cover is made of flat-weave microfibre which is delicately soft to the touch and breathable yet refreshingly durable. The Obaby Moisture Management Dual Core Mattress adapts as your little one grows and is fantastic for providing little ones with optimum support. The mattress offers an impressive four sleep options thanks to the reversible core and cover meaning you can always choose the best combination for a perfect night’s sleep. The Mattress is suitable from birth, one side of the mattress is firm which aids in muscle development, and bone growth and features an inner core comprised of coconut coir, bonded with natural latex that provides a naturally springy feel whilst being extremely resilient, durable and breathable. It is then topped with a soft and luxurious lambswool that regulates body temperature and moisture for maximum comfort as well as being naturally hypoallergenic. As your little one grows, so do their needs. This mattress can be flipped, one side offering individual pocket springs encased in high-grade, dent-resistant nursery foam. The other side gives increased support to your little ones' back, neck and head during sleep, promoting perfect posture and sweet dreams.

The Posture+ design of the carrier provides the perfect amount of support, stretch, compression and breathability exactly where you and your baby need it.

product_name: Elodie Details Changing Bag - Moonshell
description: The Elodie Details Changing Bag in Moonshell combines style, functionality, and premium quality in one chic package. With the look of an exclusive handbag, it’s perfect for everyday outings or special occasions. Thoughtfully designed with multiple pockets, a thermo pocket, and a soft changing mat, it keeps all your baby essentials, and even your own items, neatly organised. Extra-long shoulder straps and stroller loops make it effortless to carry, whether over your shoulder, across your body, or attached to your stroller.

description: The Nuna MIXX NEXT Pushchair is designed for life on the move - whether that’s daily strolls, weekend adventures or quick coffee runs. Suitable from birth right through to toddlerhood, the MIXX NEXT adapts beautifully as your baby grows. The true-flat recline is perfect for newborn naps, while the adjustable calf support and integrated footrest keep older babies cosy and supported. An all-season seat keeps things snug in cooler weather and cleverly converts to breathable mesh when the temperature rises. Finished with Nuna’s refined leather and fabric detailing, this pushchair balances thoughtful functionality with timeless style. With all-wheel suspension, a spacious storage basket and included rain cover and apron, it’s a dependable everyday companion designed to make outings feel effortless.

product_name: CYBEX Gazelle S Pushchair - Almond Beige - Taupe - None

description: Lansinoh’s award-winning HPA® Lanolin Nipple Cream is a trusted companion for breastfeeding parents around the world. description: The Joie Litetrax Pro Pushchair in Shale is equipped with all-wheel suspension, foam-filled rubber tyres, and a one-touch brake, this pushchair keeps you safe and comfortable while on the go. The SoftTouch 5-point harness plus shoulder and lower buckle covers will also keep your little passenger safe and secure on every single journey.

product_name: Maxi-Cosi Pearl S Car Seat - Tonal Graphite - No Base
description: The Maxi-Cosi Pearl S in Tonal Graphite combines the latest i-Size safety standard with comfort and convenience that parents can rely on. description: Thoughtfully designed for those more wriggly stages, The Little Bumble Co. Anti Roll Changing Mat offers a little extra reassurance during everyday changes. Proudly made in the UK, it’s a practical and comforting choice for modern family life.

product_name: Etta Loves x LIBERTY Reversible Sensory Playmat - Multicoloured - 120x120
description: Bring beauty and purpose to playtime with the Etta Loves x LIBERTY Reversible Sensory Playmat. The padded mat provides a soft, safe space for tummy time, play, and exploration - helping little ones build strength, focus, and early independence while surrounded by timeless design.

product_name: Merino Kids Go Go Toddler Sleeping Bag - All Seasons - Olive Stripe
description: Keep your little one cosy and comfortable all year round with the Merino Kids All Seasons Go Go Bag. With practical design details like a YKK zip, nickel-free domes, and a travel vent, it’s as convenient for parents as it is comfortable for babies.

product_name: Jollein Baby Mobile - Teddy Bear
description: The Jollein Baby Mobile – Teddy Bear adds a gentle, comforting touch to your baby’s playtime or bedtime routine. A beautiful choice for your own nursery or as a thoughtful maternity gift.

product_name: Jollein Footmuff - Olive Green
description: The Jollein Footmuff keeps your little one cosy, dry, and comfortable on chilly days out. product_name: Fraupow Manual Breast Pump + Milk Collector

product_name: Bugaboo Footmuff - Desert Taupe
description: The Bugaboo Footmuff will keep your little one snug and warm. This cosy all-season cocoon is designed to keep baby comfortable all year round. With a soft fleece lining, a cocoon-shaped headpiece, and a water-repellent exterior, it offers warmth and protection from wind and light rain. Plus, the quick-zip apron with a magnetic closure makes adjusting to changing weather a breeze. It’s compatible with all Bugaboo pushchairs except the Ant, and cleaning is a breeze with machine-washable fabrics. A must-have for any parent on the go!

Finished with secure side button attachments and a convenient carry bag, the TRVL dubl Footmuff ensures cosy travels all season long.

product_name: Nuna MIXX NEXT Pushchair - Pistachio - No Carrycot
description: The Nuna MIXX NEXT Pushchair is designed for life on the move - whether that’s daily strolls, weekend adventures or quick coffee runs. product_name: CYBEX Gazelle S Twin Pushchair - Almond Beige / With Seat Unit
description: The CYBEX Gazelle S Pushchair is a future-ready companion for growing families, offering over 20 configurations to suit newborns, siblings or twins. However you build it, the Gazelle S makes getting out and about with twins beautifully simple.

description: The CYBEX Sirona Gi i-Size Plus Car Seat in Moon Black keeps your little one safe and comfortable, taking you from cosy newborn days to the busy toddler years. An award-winning car seat, the Sirona Gi i-Size is the latest car seat in the Sirona line, and the most comfortable yet. Your little ones are sure to enjoy the journey. The extended rear-facing design ensures safeguarding up to 20kg, integrated Linear Side-impact Protection keeps them safe from all angles and the innovative air vents on both sides keep your little one cool and comfortable on warmer days. Add the newborn inlay accessory (available separately) to extend their comfort right from day one.

product_name: CYBEX Solution G2 Plus Car Seat - Ocean Blue
description: The Cybex Solution G2 Plus Car Seat in Ocean Blue is a high-back booster and leader in safety and comfort for your little one. Newest in the line, the Solution G2 car seat folds in half, so it's easier than ever to take your car seat in taxis, on the subway or on holiday. With a helpful handle, self-standing feature and compact size, the Solution G2 is sure you be your new favourite car seat. The Solution G2 is super safe, with side-impact protection and an adjustable head rest to keep little ones head in the safety zone of the car seat, and comfortable, with air ventilation technology to keep little ones cool, a recline function to help little ones relax and adjustable head rest and wings for the perfect fit.

product_name: BabyBjörn Baby Carrier Mini - 3D Mesh - Cream
description: Keep your little one close from day one with the BabyBjörn Baby Carrier Mini - thoughtfully designed for the precious early months when closeness matters most. Soft, snug, and wonderfully easy to use, Baby Carrier Mini offers a cosy and secure space for newborns while helping you keep your hands free for everyday moments. Designed specifically for babies from birth, no additional infant insert is needed. The soft fabrics gently support your baby's back, hips, legs, and head, while three carrying positions allow flexibility as your little one grows. Recognised by the International Hip Dysplasia Institute as a hip-healthy product, it provides reassuring support from the very beginning. Available in beautifully soft fabrics including breathable 3D Mesh, stretchy 3D Jersey, and durable woven materials with recycled fibres, Baby Carrier Mini is crafted with comfort, practicality, and everyday family life in mind. Made using baby-safe certified fabrics and designed for easy machine washing, it’s a simple companion for those first cuddles, walks, and adventures together.

product_name: CYBEX Amya Baby Carrier - Magic Black
description: From day one through toddlerhood, the CYBEX Amya Baby Carrier grows with your little one, making everyday adventures effortless and comfortable. Designed to self-adapt to your baby’s body, it offers four ergonomic carrying positions for ultimate flexibility while keeping your child close and secure. Breathable 3D mesh fabric ensures you both stay cool, while padded support encourages healthy hips and spine development. product_name: Tommee Tippee Uv Steriliser Dryer
description: The Tommee Tippee Uv Steriliser Dryer is the fuss-free and super clean way to sterilise, dry and store your baby’s bottles in a sterile environment. No more wet bottles - with the Ultra UV Steriliser, you get clean, sterilised baby bottles when you need them without the use of water or steam. The steriliser uses solely Ultraviolet light which is a form of invisible light that kills 99.9% of micro-organisms. It’s an effective way to disinfect against harmful bacteria, mould, viruses* and other germs without the use of chemicals and is often used to sterilise equipment used in hospitals, dentists and doctor’s surgeries. Now Tommee Tippee have brought it into the home in a safe and easy to use unit. The highly reflective interior of the sterilising unit helps the UV light to bounce around to ensure all areas of your baby bottles and other feeding accessories are fully sterilised. Sterilise and dry up to 6 bottles in just 60 minutes or choose the 30-minute dry-only mode if your bottle is already sterile. In storage mode, the unit will run a programme that emits 5 minutes of UV light and 5 minutes of drying every 2 hours to ensure that items inside stay sterile. You can open the door and remove items then choose the storage programme again. This UV Steriliser is suitable for a wide range of branded bottles, soothers and breast pump accessories and features adjustable shelves. The steriliser unit features a replaceable and washable filter which helps keep dust and dirt particles out of the air used to dry your bottles and feeding accessories, so they stay clean once sterilised. The UV light is also perfect for quickly charging the brand's glow in the dark products, such as the Night-Time Breast-Like Soother.

description: The Little Green Sheep Organic Cot Bed Mattress 60x120cm has been beautifully crafted using natural ingredients and is free from any harmful toxins and chemicals, giving you peace of mind that your little one is sleeping in a pure and natural environment. product_name: Tommee Tippee Electric Bottle Warmer
description: The Tommee Tippee Easiwarm Electric Bottle Warmer allows you to warm your baby’s feed to the perfect temperature in as little as 4 minutes. Equipped with a one-dial operation and three settings, you can choose to warm from fridge temperature, room temperature or to keep baby’s food warm. Compatible with a wide range of branded baby bottles, you can warm your baby’s feeds from birth and throughout their weaning journey. The Easiwarm warmer will automatically work out the optimum warming time based on the setting you choose and the starting temperature of the bottle. Gradual, gentle warming helps to preserve the goodness and vital nutrients in your baby’s food and heats it to a comfortable body temperature that feels natural to baby. It also helps to prevent hot spots that could burn your baby’s mouth. Once the warm is complete, simply remove the bottle from the warmer and avoid touching the water inside. Please note: Depending upon capacity and starting temperature of feed. A warming time of 4 minutes is based on heating a 150ml serving of milk from ambient room temperature (20c)

product_name: Tommee Tippee Travel Bottle Warmer
description: The Tommee Tippee Travel Bottle Warmer allows you to warm your baby’s feed to the perfect temperature while out and about. It requires no external heating source, making it ideal for travelling. It doesn’t require electricity and is a convenient and fuss-free way to heat baby bottles and baby food on the go. It heats everything from breast milk or formula to baby food in jars or pouches. It’s compact enough to fit in your baby’s changing bag so you’re able to heat feeds anywhere, anytime. The stainless steel, thermally insulated flask safely stores hot water and keeps it hot so it’s ready to heat your baby’s next feed. It fastens with a secure lid that prevents hot water from leaking into your bag and is made from BPA and phthalate-free materials. The Travel Bottle and Food Warmer has been specially designed to fit all Tommee Tippee Closer to Nature Bottles and a wide range of branded baby food jars and pouches. Easy to use 1. Pour boiling water into the insulated thermal container and securely fasten the lid 2. When ready to use, pour the water from the thermal container into the lid 3. Place the bottle into hot water to warm. Once warm, remove the bottle and test the temperature before giving the bottle to the baby

product_name: Britax Romer Baby-Safe Pro Car Seat - Midnight Grey - With Vario Base 5Z
description: The Britax Römer BABY-SAFE PRO is the brand’s lightest and most innovative infant carrier yet, designed to keep your little one safe, supported and comfortable from birth up to approximately 15 months. The base also offers adjustable positioning to help achieve the best seat angle in different vehicles. Specially designed newborn inserts provide added support and comfort during those early weeks, while the adjustable headrest and harness adapt as your baby grows. Awarded the AGR “Healthy Back” certification and recognised with multiple design awards, the BABY-SAFE PRO combines advanced safety, ergonomic comfort and everyday convenience in one beautifully designed infant carrier.
